about: The binding of isaac: rebirth is the roguelike whose item-synergy chaos became the genre's benchmark: isaac cries his way through procedurally stacked basements, and the item pool's collisions - tears that spiral, split, ignite or homing - make every run a different gun. The floors' boss gates, the devil-deal economy and the unlock avalanche give it the long game.

Nicalis and edmund mcmillen shipped rebirth in november 2014, replacing the original flash build; the steam listing is the current official door with the dlc content tiers riding the same page's ecosystem. Still sold.
A light 2d pixel game - the haswell igpu bar holds it at 1080p60 with headroom. Not-tested stands until a run confirms install, launch and saves.
